_readme: Company career pages the robot reads. Add as many as you like.
Required: website. Optional: name, careers (exact careers URL), cat, loc, logo.
Without 'careers' the robot tries /careers, /career, /jobs and a few more.
Only pages that publish schema.org JobPosting data are read, so a company that
publishes nothing structured is skipped and counted in robot/report.json.
robots.txt is checked for every host before any request.
